name: ION: Mnogolikij
source: In the story of the loser who was hit by a bus and ended up in a pioneer camp, there are many more stories that previously remained a mystery. The story of one loser is not over. This is just the beginning...
translation: 在失败者被公交车撞到拓荒者营地的故事中，还有更多以前一直是个谜的故事。一个失败者的故事还没有结束。这只是开始……
